chapters.label: Live: the Euro 2022 semi-final
chapters.text: Euro 2022 semi-final. Portugal were two down to Spain, but Zicky made it two all. One minute to go, and Zicky scores again! Three two!

chapters.label: Champions of Europe
chapters.text: Two days later, Portugal beat Russia in the final. Champions of Europe! And Zicky is player of the tournament.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His trademark is the hold-up and turn. Here’s how he does it: back to goal, he sits low and holds off the defender. He feels him lean, spins, and shoots!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Your turn: back to goal, hold off the defender, spin and shoot!
